name: infracortex
displayName: InfraCortex — DevOps AI agents for Copilot & Claude Code
description: One-click DevOps agents: Terraform (Azure/AWS), Kubernetes, Docker and FinOps experts in GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, with security scanners, a destructive-command guard, self-learning skill memory (CortexWeave) and Azure diagrams.

chatAgents.name: terraform-expert
chatAgents.description: Terraform engineer for Azure and AWS: review, write, refactor and debug .tf, state and IaC pipelines with security baselines.

chatAgents.name: kubernetes-expert
chatAgents.description: Kubernetes/AKS troubleshooter: CrashLoop, Pending, OOMKilled, ImagePull, networking, RBAC; reviews and writes manifests.

chatAgents.name: docker-expert
chatAgents.description: Docker and container-security expert: Dockerfiles, Compose, image size, CVEs, hardening, build → run → verify.

chatAgents.name: finops-expert
chatAgents.description: Azure/AWS FinOps analyst: waste, rightsizing, Infracost diffs, price lookups. Read-only.

chatAgents.name: devops-expert
chatAgents.description: All-in-one DevOps agent combining Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and FinOps for cross-domain tasks.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with InfraCortex
walkthroughs.description: Three clicks: tools, Claude Code, then pick an agent.

steps.title: Check and install prerequisites
steps.description:
Finds Git/Git Bash, Python, jq and the DevOps scanners (terraform, tflint, trivy, hadolint, kubectl, az, docker).
[Check prerequisites](command:infracortex.checkPrereqs)
[Install missing tools](command:infracortex.installPrereqs)

steps.title: Use the agents in GitHub Copilot
steps.description:
The agents, skills and MCP tools are already registered. Open Copilot Chat in Agent mode and pick an agent.
[Open Copilot Chat](command:infracortex.openCopilotAgent)

steps.title: Enable in Claude Code (one click)
steps.description:
Adds the InfraCortex plugin to Claude Code: subagents with memory, the safety guard, self-learning and the live HUD.
[Enable in Claude Code](command:infracortex.enableClaude)

steps.title: Optional: one-click scans
steps.description: Right-click a folder or Dockerfile for scans that put findings in the Problems panel — no AI, no tokens.

commands.title: Open Copilot Chat with an Agent

devopsAgents.defaultRegion.description: Default Azure region for price lookups.

devopsAgents.installOptionalTools.description: Also install optional tools (Docker Desktop, Infracost) with 'Install Missing Tools'.
